basics.name: Shubha Sanket Samantaray
basics.label: M2 MVA student — Applied Mathematics & Machine Learning
basics.summary: Master's student in Mathématiques, Vision, Apprentissage (MVA) at ENS Paris-Saclay / Université Paris-Saclay, with interests in deep learning, stochastic differential equations, optimal transport, and machine learning for time series.

work.name: Computational and Applied Mathematics Lab (CAMLab), SAM, D-Math, ETH Zürich
work.summary: Working on the development of diffusion-based certificates of trust for AI prediction models.

work.name: AIRSEA team, Laboratoire Jean Kuntzmann (CNRS)
work.summary: Worked on statistical inference methods to calibrate the diffusion term in stochastic differential equations. Developed and validated parametric SDE models to approximate complex dynamical systems, analyzing trade-offs between model stability and accuracy.

projects.name: Feynman-Kac Based PDE Solver using Machine Learning
projects.summary: Neural network-based PDE solver using the Feynman–Kac formula; applied to the Black–Scholes equation for pricing European options. Systematic comparison against Finite Difference and Monte Carlo methods.

projects.name: Auto-Encoder with Regression for Time Series Anomaly Detection
projects.summary: PyTorch implementation of the Auto-Encoder with Regression framework for time series anomaly detection, with alternative thresholding strategies and compatibility with recent Python versions.

projects.name: Deep Learning-Based Volatility Forecasting
projects.summary: Symbol-aware time-series pipeline on the Oxford–Man Realized Volatility dataset; deep learning volatility forecasters using realized volatility and daily returns, evaluated with MSE, QLIKE, and directional accuracy.

projects.name: Fitting a Stochastic Differential Equation to the Lorenz Trajectory
projects.summary: SDE models approximating the dynamics of the Lorenz system, analysing trade-offs between complexity, stability and fidelity of the reproduced dynamics.
